name: com.storyloom.unity
description: Runtime + editor kit for stories exported from Storyloom: loads the .unity.json, plays the graph (variables, choices, checks, inventory, events, discoverables), binds characters/items/locations to prefabs, validates, and generates a playable test scene in a top-down (Stardew-style), third-person or first-person style.

samples.displayName: The Lantern Road (example story + minimal player)
samples.description: The sample project's Unity export plus a bare-bones uGUI player that uses only the runtime.
